title: nf-WGS-QC - params.input_bam schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input_bam

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

sex.errorMessage: Sex must be provided in the format M/F/NA or 1/2/0

alignment_file.errorMessage: Alignment file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam' or '.cram'

regions_bed.errorMessage: When provided, regions BED file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bed' or '.bed.gz'
